reason: B binary is a name-and-digest descriptor, portable by name, with the digest there for a receiver's own observation to differ on -- the divergence two honest runs of one recipe produced is by design, not a leak. The gap the finding actually uncovered was different: a hygiene run could once reach for any binary on the host's own search path, whether or not anything installed had asked for it as tooling. A hygiene run now names only a binary some installed module has declared as a requirement, refused by name before anything spawns otherwise.
